text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
With the members of the Mercurius Foundation reunited,
together with {0}, they discuss the nature of the
great Island Whale on which they find themselves stranded.
text_block_list.orig_text:
【メルクリウス財団】の４人が全員そろった。
{0}を含めて５人は、
この島全体が島クジラという魔物であることを共有した。

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... If everything you say is true,
we should be able to speak with the island itself
by sailing offshore and calling out to it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど……
タマキさんたちの話が本当なら、
沖からこの島に呼びかければ、
島クジラと話ができるのですわね……

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
First we negotiate...
And if that doesn't work, we'll have to use force!
Either way, we're leaving this place and returning to reality!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずは話しあって……
それでもだめなら
実力行使ですわ！
そして、
現実世界に帰していただきますわよ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Yes... I think we've been here long enough!
choice_data_list: We can do this if we work together!
Actually, I'd kind of like to stay here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
現実へ帰らなきゃね！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Right! We're going home, no matter what!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇ、
なんとしても帰らなくっちゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nyo way!
We're done with running away from reality!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメだにゃ！
あたしたちは、
もう現実から目を逸らさないにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's get on this raft and take to the waves!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
全員いかだに乗って、
沖まで行きますわよ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: So... We've paddled a fair way from the shore...
text_block_list.orig_text:
と、
勢い良く海に出てみたものの……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
But even from out here, I can't see a face anywhere on the island...
Are you sure it's a monster?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今までいた島、
こうやって外から見ても顔なんてついてないし……
本当に魔物なのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
There's nyo doubt about it! That thing's the Island Whale!
The diary laid it all out, nyice and clear!
text_block_list.orig_text:
間違いないにゃ！
　あれは島クジラなのにゃ！
手記にそう書いてあったのにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! Big fella! Island Whale!
We've had enough of your fake old island!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーーーい！
　こらーーーー！
　島クジラーーー！
あたしたちを、
この島から出すにゃーーー！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: How very odd... There's no response...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかしいわね、
反応がない……

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
Tamaki, Mifuyu...
Could it be that you're still caught in some kind of illusion?
Who can say if that diary was even real...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
タマキさん、
ミフユさん……
もしかして、
あなたたち
まだ幻想を見ているのではありませんこと？
その手記も本当にあったのか……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I-it's just gotta be real...
We should definitely be able to talk to the whale...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんなはずないにゃ……
本当に島クジラと対話ができるはずにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know!
text_block_list.orig_text: わかったわ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: What is it now, Mifuyu?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたの、
ミフユさん？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
That whale is fueled by greed!
Instead of provoking it with fighting words,
we should catch its interest with something it cares about!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいつは、欲深いのよ！
けんか腰で話しかけるんじゃなくて、
あいつが興味ありそうなことを言えばいいの！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see! That certainly sounds worth a try!
Oh, Mr. Island Whale!
I have a little deal to offer you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど、
それでは私が試してみますわ！
島クジラさまーー！
いい取引の話がありますのー！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Is it just me, or do you feel some kind of shaking?
...An earthquake?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？
　なんだか、
地響きがしてないかしら……
地震？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Ahh! Look, everyone! The island's rising out of the water!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ？　
みんな、あれを見て！
　島が浮上していくわ！

text_block_list.name: Island Whale
text_block_list.text: ...GRROOOAAAHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──おおおおおおッ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Aaaahhh?! A gigantic face appeared from beneath the waves!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひえっ！？
　島が浮かんで顔が現れたーーっ！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: So that island really was a monster all along...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの島、
本当に魔物だったのね……！

text_block_list.name: Island Whale
text_block_list.text:
Tiny humans... What deal do you offer...?
Do you ask, like the human before you,
that I spare your meager lives so that you may bring others?
text_block_list.orig_text:
人間よ……
取引とは、
なんだ……？
また、
以前いた人間のように、
この島の存在を広めるから
見逃して欲しいとでも言うのか……？

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, I think not.
Tell me, would you like to form a contract with me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいえ、
違いますわ。
あなた、
おいくらで契約していただけますの？

text_block_list.name: Island Whale
text_block_list.text: A contract...?
text_block_list.orig_text: 契約……？

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
Your goal is to collect the desires of humans, is it not?
In that case, the Mercurius Foundation would like to offer you
a business opportunity! We'll promote you far and wide!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたは、
人間の欲望を集めたいのですわよね？
でしたら、
我が【メルクリウス財団】と手を組んでビジネスに
してみませんこと？
　大々的に宣伝しますわよ？

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: I'll call it the One-Week Dream Life Island Experience!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その名も、
『一週間だけ夢のような暮らしを提供するサービス』！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
We will transport customers directly to your island to grant their desires,
and before they die, we will forcibly return them to their lives!
It will be a massively popular attraction!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お客様に
一週間だけこの島クジラで欲望を叶えていただいて、
死んでしまう前に
強制的に連れ帰るサービスを始めるのですわ！
これは、
大繁盛間違いなしですわよ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Oh, Akino... You do come up with the wildest ideas...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アキノさん、
めちゃくちゃなこと考えるな～……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
But that does sound like an efficient solution...
The only question is whether the Whale will take the bait.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもそれなら確かに、効率もいいわね……
問題は、
島クジラがこの提案に乗るか……

text_block_list.name: Island Whale
text_block_list.text:
Preposterous!
Did you truly believe I would debase myself
to become a tool for human entertainment?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふざけるな……！
そんな貴様ら人間の道具になるようなことを、
ワシが聞くとでも思ったかああああ！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: It made him angry?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 怒りましたわ！？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Well, at the end of the day, he [i]is[/i] a monster...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
そりゃそうだよね、
魔物だもん……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? What's this?
As the Island Whale sinks...
Something is spurting up from its back...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？
　何かしら？
沈んでいく島クジラが、
何かを背中から一斉に吹き出してる……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Oww! These little hard things...
Hey, look... They're CatCoins!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいたっ！　
固くてちっちゃな……
これは……
キャットコインにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
So the coins really did exist...
Maybe they're treasure left behind by the pirate crew
that was stranded here before us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このコインは実在してたのね……
もしかしたら、
昔にこの島に漂着した
海賊のお宝だったのかも！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we made some unexpected profit!
But there's still one question left...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだか、思いがけず儲かっちゃった！
でも、
それより問題は……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Can we actually get all the way back to Landosol on this raft?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで、
本当にランドソルへ帰れるのかってことよね……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Exactly... *yawn*...
The thought of it is making me sleepy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当ね……
ふあーあ……
と思ったら急に眠たくなってきた……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
*yawn*... This drowsy sensation feels awfully familiar...
But this time, it's going to take us [i]away[/i] from the island, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふあ～……
この眠気は、何度も経験したけど……
今回は、
抜け出すための眠気のはず……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Will we be all right...?
Will we actually make it back home this time...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫かにゃあ……
今度は、ちゃんと……
帰れるかにゃぁ……？

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
Tell you what... Let's hold hands to make sure we stay together.
All of us... The Mercurius Foundation... Together... forever...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなら……
万が一の時に備えて手を繋いでおきましょう。
私たち……
【メルクリウス財団】は、
いつも
一緒ですわよ……
